captions.instagram:
Concept redesign of a fictional bakery. Not a client project.

Some bakery sites still take orders with a PDF you download, print, fill in and email back. Meanwhile the one thing people want, what is baked today, is stuck in a loading Instagram feed.

So we led with baking-now hours, one tap to reserve a loaf, today’s shelf as real text and a map one scroll down.

Does your site do this? Free review at prycedigital.com/book

captions.linkedin:
Concept redesign: a fictional country bakery homepage, rebuilt for the phone.

The old version opens with a full-screen slider, takes orders through a PDF you download and email back, and leaves today’s bakes in a loading Instagram feed.

The new one leads with baking-now hours, lets you reserve a loaf in one tap, lists today’s shelf as real text, and puts the map one scroll down.

Not a client project. If your site does any of this, I am happy to take a look: prycedigital.com/book
